additional_info.subject: charging abroted during precharge
additional_info.body:
Hello,
My name is Benjamin Perske and I’m working for the company AKKODIS on a BMW charging infrastructure project.
Recently one of our drivers had some issues with one of your stations. The charging session was always aborted during Precharge.
Provider: Virta
Location: Maria-Probst-Straße 6, 80939 München
Time: 07.01.2026 [17:07:26]
SerialNr.: R6 / 170001959 (s. Label.jpeg)
EVSE-ID: 216878
Are there any know issues with this station? Could you please have a look at it?
Thank you and best regards
Benjamin Perske
Benjamin Perske
Digital Engineer Consultant E-Mobility & Powertrain Leipzig (DCE)

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0475546-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170001959] Precharge Session Abort CRM:03276000081
additional_info.body:
Hello everyone,
The response from our colleagues took a bit longer than expected, sorry for that.
They can see that the car  is only receiving 255V during precharge although the car request 610V.
Strangely enough the charging station itself sends the value 610V.
It seems that there is a problem with the sensor of the station. Could you please check that?
This issue could be reproduced by our colleagues at this station. At the neighboring station charging was possible without any issues.
Thank you and best regards
Benjamin
CONFIDENTIAL
